title: macroptilium gracile
intro: Macroptilium gracile, commonly known as sensitive plant or goosefoot, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family, Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Macroptilium gracile include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, but it is reported to contain flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
